categories.distribution: Canonical Workflow implementation. Copied byte-for-byte into the payload and installed into every managed target repository.

rules.rationale: New command mirroring /record-manual-plan-review.md: ingests the MANUAL_EXTERNAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW stage of the two-stage implementation-review protocol (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP4).
New operator guide for the two-stage implementation-review protocol, mirroring PLAN_REVIEW_WORKFLOW.md (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP1).

Gains a "2.2" authoritative branch (phase guard AWAITING_LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW, ledger write plus phase transition on APPROVE/REVISE); its existing "1"/"2.1" steps 1-8 stay byte-unchanged (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP4). The authoritative branch's A6 write set additionally gains the same assert_feedback_not_owned_by_other_work_item ownership guard the advisory branch's own step 7 already runs immediately before its write, closing a gap the advisory branch never had (I3, round-2 finding). Preserves the base release's own distribution category for this path.

Gains a "2.2" branch: step 0's enter_applying_review_feedback entry becomes phase-conditional rather than version-conditional, skipped whenever phase is already APPLYING_REVIEW_FEEDBACK -- which the ordinary "2.2" REVISE loop always is -- and still called for a "2.2" item at the terminal AWAITING_EXTERNAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW phase; post-fix regeneration reaches AWAITING_LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW via record_bundle_generation's own version-dependent resolver (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP4). Preserves the base release's own distribution category for this path.

technical_approval_gate_reachable's widened entry condition (a "2.2"-only ledger check mirroring plan_approval_gate_reachable) and the version-dependent bundle-generation provenance-interval check (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP1/CP3).
Step 0's governing-version enumeration widened from "1"/"2.1" to include "2.2" (workflow-2.5.0); steps 1-8 still run identically for all three (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP4).

Two hunks: post-fix bounded-fix regeneration routes back through both implementation-review stages for a "2.2" work item before /approve-review implementation is reachable again; and the child work-item lifecycle chain inserts /record-manual-implementation-review <child-id> for a "2.2"-governed child and states that such a child enters review at AWAITING_LOCAL_PLAN_REVIEW identically to a "2.1" child (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP5).

governing_workflow_version activation references widened to include the new "2.2" target; also corrects the prior claim that the "2.1" branch is inert for this repository's own work items (workflow-2.5.0 correction, LOCAL_MODEL_PLAN_REVIEW round 5) and adds an explicit any-other-version refusal branch (round-7 optional finding 2) (D-Implementation-Review-Version-Activation, CP1/CP2).

Bundle-generation-record step's target-phase reference generalized to bundle_generation_target_phase(stage, governing_workflow_version), plus an explicit any-other-governing_workflow_version refusal branch added to step 0's branch selection (round-7 optional finding 2) (D-Implementation-Review-Stages "Provenance-interval interaction", CP3).
governing_workflow_version references widened for the new "2.2" activation target (D-Implementation-Review-Version-Activation, CP1/CP2).

Step 0's legacy-adoption target corrected to always the literal "2.1", never config["default_workflow_version"] (workflow-2.5.0 correction, LOCAL_MODEL_PLAN_REVIEW round 6 optional finding 1), plus a new statement that steps 1-5 are themselves version-independent, reachable identically for "1", "2.1", or "2.2" alike (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP4).

Governing-version check widened from a bare "2.1" literal to TWO_STAGE_PLAN_REVIEW_VERSIONS membership ("2.1"/"2.2"), with the description: frontmatter updated to match (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP4).

Recovered-role committed-phase membership test widened to bundle_generation_recovered_role_legal_committed_phases(governing_workflow_version)'s three-phase "2.2" set (D-Implementation-Review-Stages "Provenance-interval interaction", CP3).
governing_workflow_version references widened for the "2.2" activation target (D-Implementation-Review-Version-Activation, CP1/CP2).

Phase-guard version enumeration widened from "1"/"2.1" to include "2.2" (workflow-2.5.0), since MILESTONE_WORKFLOW.md defines this state identically for all three (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP4).

Governing-version check widened from a bare "2.1" literal to TWO_STAGE_PLAN_REVIEW_VERSIONS membership ("2.1"/"2.2"), with the description: frontmatter updated to match -- the same semantic change as sibling record-manual-plan-review.md (D-Implementation-Review-Version-Activation, CP4). Step 8's write set additionally gains the same assert_feedback_not_owned_by_other_work_item ownership guard /review-implementation's advisory branch already runs immediately before its own write -- this command had never had it (I3, round-2 finding; a faithful mirror of the pre-existing gap, closed here rather than left as its second instance).
The two new AWAITING_LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW / AWAITING_MANUAL_EXTERNAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW states and their transition edges (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP1).

Applicability widened, not merely cross-referenced: the title and the "Scoped entirely to '2.1' work items" paragraph now read TWO_STAGE_PLAN_REVIEW_VERSIONS = {"2.1", "2.2"}, and /apply-plan-review's described exit widens to name both versions alike (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP1).

D-Review-Finding-Taxonomy-and-Circuit-Breaker's advisory [substantive]/[apparatus] tagging convention and circuit-breaker signal (CP8); implementation-review-stage bundle/manifest references widened for "2.2" (CP1).
Persisted-phases/writer tables, command count and the new /record-manual-implementation-review section, widened for the "2.2" implementation-review stages (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP1/CP4).

D-Implementation-Review-Stages, D-Implementation-Review-Version-Activation (CP1) and D-Review-Material-Lifecycle (CP6) design-decision sections -- the only checkpoints that actually authored this file (git log 38114204..HEAD -- this path is exactly 20a808d/CP1 and 2af606a/CP6). D-Canonical-Review-Data lives in scripts/workflow_state_test.py (CP7), D-Review-Finding-Taxonomy-and-Circuit-Breaker in REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md (CP8), and D-Post-v2.3.1-Backlog is a plan-internal label for CP9/CP10's own code-fix and docs/defects/ deliverables, not a section in this document.
Persisted-phase table, phase-to-writer census, command-count and generator-mention checks updated for the two new commands and phases (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP2/CP3/CP4).

KNOWN_PHASES additions, the generalized version-aware activation/rollback helpers, implementation_review_stages ledger writers (record_local_implementation_review, record_manual_implementation_review), the widened technical_approval_gate_reachable, and bundle_generation_target_phase/bundle_generation_recovered_role_legal_committed_phases (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, D-Implementation-Review-Version-Activation; CP1-CP3, CP9, CP10). Round 7's own I1 (implementation-review-two-stage's REVISE round 7): technical_approval_gate_reachable's three "2.2" widening parameters are now required keyword-only parameters, no longer defaulted to None, closing a fail-open gap where a caller that omitted governing_workflow_version got the gate's answer unconditionally True with the "2.2" ledger never consulted. Also adds find_applying_review_feedback_version_claims/sweep_applying_review_feedback_version_claims, a standing negative-corpus sweep for the recurring superseded "enter_applying_review_feedback is skipped for '2.2' because of a version branch" documentation claim (round 7's own B1).

Round 7's own I1 (implementation-review-two-stage's REVISE round 7): MatrixCase.approve_implementation's shared technical_approval_gate_reachable call, and three narrow unit-test calls, updated to pass the now-required governing_workflow_version/implementation_review_stages/current_review_content_id keyword arguments explicitly (None for every existing '1'/'2.1' row this suite drives, behavior-preserving via the function's own != "2.2" branch) -- otherwise every conformance/bootstrap-e2e/disposable-repo suite exercising a '1'/'2.1' item's technical-approval path raises TypeError against this milestone's own I1 fix. Preserves the base release's own distribution category for this path.

TestNeverPersistedPhaseVocabulary's PERSISTED frozenset and its AST-derivation helper widened for the two new persisted phases, one of them (AWAITING_LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW) reachable only through bundle_generation_target_phase's call indirection (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP11).

The payload's own conformance suite, updated for the new review-stage writers/gates plus CP7's generic, parametric declaration-coverage helper generalizing the bespoke per-work-item pattern (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, D-Canonical-Review-Data; CP2, CP3, CP7).
